analogs.covers: Hunting and climate: a thick-furred, cold-loving ambush cat that takes prey far bigger than itself and dens in rocky shelters
Life: playful family groups around a den, and a coat that changes with the seasons

headline: A snow leopard that lives in a playful arctic-fox family: cold-loving, den-dwelling, and bold enough to hunt the biggest predators.

setting.label: Cool, rainy-season forests and hills; dens
setting.note: Thrives in the cooler rainy season and struggles in dry-season heat, becoming lazy and hunting only at night then. Claims whole POIs in full groups and defends resting and nesting dens.

playsLike: You are a large, feathered tyrannosaurid in a group of up to 6: a related 'clowder' or an unrelated 'colony'. You are always singing, playing and performing. Solo you hunt up to Medium tier, a pair up to Large, and 3–4 up to Apex, and you particularly enjoy hunting Tyrannosaurus, Giganotosaurus and Tyrannotitan. Hunts are coordinated: two spook prey toward the others, or everyone charges, baits and bites joints and tendons, and one member manages the heal calls. In the dry season you prefer sleeping, injured or young targets.

why.text: Prefers the cool rainy season and struggles to regulate its temperature in the dry season. Snow leopards and arctic foxes are cold-climate specialists (official inspiration).
Optionally shifts its pelt with the seasons, vibrant in the rains and dull in the dry, like an arctic fox's summer and winter coats.
Chooses dens to rest and nest in and defends them fiercely, like fox dens and snow leopard caves.
Only 3,250 combat weight, yet a party of 3–4 hunts Apex carnivores. Snow leopards kill prey several times their own weight.
A family group is called a 'clowder', the collective noun for cats (official inspiration: feral cats).

notLike: Snow leopards are solitary; Yutyrannus is intensely social.
Arctic foxes are small scavengers; Yutyrannus is a Large-tier hunter.
twist: Birds of paradise (official inspiration): males court with song-and-dance performances they perfect over a lifetime.
